protocol.start: cold start from the original Solomon input and frozen vehicle cap
protocol.objective: lexicographic (vehicles, distance); our solver uses direct lexicographic selection and the reference adapters use their recorded dominating fixed vehicle cost
protocol.budget: search budget excludes external model construction; preparation and search are reported separately
protocol.validation: feasibility and objective values are taken from central validation recorded in runs.csv
